records.name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Postdoctoral Fellowships
records.evidence: Read the MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships action page (last updated 30 September 2026), which carries the call banner 'The call is closed. The 2027 call will open on 7 April 2027' and states the two fellowship types, the PhD and eight-year research-experience requirements and the 12-month-in-36-months mobility rule. Also read the official MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2027 call page, which publishes the indicative timeline '7 April 2027: launch of the call for proposals (TBC)' and '8 September 2027: deadline for submitting proposals (TBC)' and an indicative budget of 'EUR 388.57 million (TBC)'.

records.name: Erasmus+ Student Exchange for Study Abroad (Erasmus+ studying abroad mobility)
records.evidence: Read the Erasmus+ official 'Studying abroad' page (last updated 18 December 2025). It confirms the scheme and its rules: 'There's no central application form to study abroad with Erasmus+. You can reach out to the international or Erasmus+ office of your university', 'students at short-cycle, Bachelor and Master levels' and 'Doctoral candidates' may apply, 'long-term mobility: minimum of 2 months to a maximum of 12 months abroad', 'short-term mobility: between 5 and 30 days abroad', and 'As an Erasmus+ student, you are exempt from fees for tuition, registration, examinations, and charges for access to laboratories or libraries at the receiving institution.'

records.name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Networks
records.evidence: Read the MSCA Doctoral Networks action page (last updated 29 September 2026) and the official MSCA Doctoral Networks 2026 call page. The call page states the indicative timeline '28 May 2026: launch of the call for proposals (TBC)', '24 November 2026: deadline for submitting proposals (TBC)', 'April 2027: notification of call results to applicants' and an 'Indicative budget EUR 593.034 million (TBC)'. The action page confirms the applicant-side rules: recruited researchers 'must not have a doctoral degree at the date of their recruitment', 'can be of any nationality' and must 'spend at least 50% of their time outside academia, for Industrial Doctorates'.

records.name: France Excellence Europa Scholarship Programme
records.evidence: Read Campus France's official programme page and its scholarship-holder memorandum (updated 12 August 2026, which confirms the scheme is still operating). The programme page states 'Developed by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs, the "France Excellence Europa" scholarship program allows students from 26 European Union countries to obtain scholarships to study at the Master's level in a French institution of higher education' and 'Payment of a half-yearly allowance of 6,850 EUR'. The memorandum confirms 'an installation allowance of 1,700 EUR' and 'a half-yearly allowance of 6,850 EUR', and states 'In other situations, course fees are not covered by the France Excellence Europa program.'
